==English== {{wp}} ===Etymology=== {{etymon|en|:inh|enm:different|tree=1}} From {{inh|en|enm|different}}, from {{der|en|fro|different}}, from {{uder|en|la|differēns}}, present active participle of {{m|la|differō||to differ}}. See also {{m|en|differ}}. Mostly {{lg|displaced|supplanted}} native {{noncog|ang|ungelic}} in common usage, which lives on as {{m|en|unalike}} in {{w|Modern English}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/ˈdɪf.ə.ɹənt/|/ˈdɪf.ɹənt/|a=RP,AU,ZA}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈdɪf.ɚ.ənt/|/ˈdɪf.ɹənt/|a=GA,CA}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-different.ogg|a=GA}} * {{hyph|en|dif|fer|ent}} ===Adjective=== {{en-adj}} # {{sid|en|not the same}} Not the [[same]]; exhibiting a [[difference]]. #: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:different}} #: {{ant|en|undifferent|Thesaurus:similar}} #: {{ux|en|— Is your grandpa any better?
— No '''different'''. Still ill.}} #*: One interesting feature was remarked by Dr. Peters, viz.: that the instrument used for the longitudes of the original catalogue was graduated '''differently''' to that used for the latitudes. #* {{quote-book|en|year=1971|author=William S. Burroughs|title={{w|The Wild Boys (novel)|The Wild Boys: A Book of the Dead}}|page=6 |passage=Enter the American tourist. He thinks of himself as a good guy but when he looks in the mirror to shave this good guy he has to admit that "well, other people are '''different''' from me and I don't really like them." This makes him feel guilty toward other people.}} #* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-07-19|author=Ian Sample|title=Irregular bedtimes may affect children's brains|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly|volume=189|issue=6|page=34|url=https://www.theguardian.com/lifeandstyle/2013/jul/08/irregular-bedtimes-affect-childrens-brains |passage=Irregular bedtimes may disrupt healthy brain development in young children, according to a study of intelligence and sleeping habits. ¶ Going to bed at a '''different''' time each night affected girls more than boys, but both fared worse on mental tasks than children who had a set bedtime, researchers found.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20261018015540/https://www.theguardian.com/lifeandstyle/2013/jul/08/irregular-bedtimes-affect-childrens-brains|archivedate=18 October 2026}} # {{sid|en|various}} [[various|Various]], [[assorted]], [[diverse]]. #: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:assorted}} #: {{ant|en|undifferent|homogeneous}} #: {{ux|en|My daughter told me about all the '''different''' animals she saw at the zoo.}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=2006|author=Delbert S. Elliott; et al|title=Good Kids from Bad Neighborhoods: Successful Development in Social Context|url=http://books.google.com/books?id=Ltx9_9NU4v0C|page=19|publisher=Cambridge University Press|isbn=9780521863575 |passage=In any case, poor black respondents living in high-poverty neighborhoods are most likely to view their neighborhood as a single block or block group and to use this definition consistently when asked about '''different''' neighborhood characteristics and activities.}} # [[distinct|Distinct]], [[separate]]; {{n-g|used for emphasis after numbers and other determiners of quantity}}. #: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:separate}} #: {{ant|en|undifferent|Thesaurus:equal}} #: {{ux|en|Several '''different''' scientists all reached this conclusion at about the same time.}} # Unlike most others; [[unusual]]. #: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:strange}} #: {{ant|en|undifferent|Thesaurus:normal}} #: {{ux|en|What do you think of my new hairdo? - Well, it's '''different'''.}} ====Usage notes==== * {{sense|not the same}} Depending on dialect, time period, and register, the adjective {{m|en||different|not the same}} may be construed with one of the prepositions {{m|en|from}}, {{m|en|to}}, and {{m|en|than}}, or with the subordinating conjunction {{m|en|than}}. Of these, {{m|en||from}} is more common in formal registers than in informal ones; {{m|en||than}} is more common in the US; and {{m|en||to}} is more common in the UK, in Australia{{,}} and in New Zealand. Style guides often advocate {{m|en||different from}}, by analogy with {{m|en|differ|differ from}} rather than {{m|en||*differ than}} or {{m|en||*differ to}}, and {{lg|proscribe}} {{m|en||different than}} and {{m|en||different to}}. ====Derived terms==== {{col|en|couldn't be more different|dance to a different tune|diffability|different as chalk and cheese|different breed of cat|different
